comment: The office's recorded stock file for the Inventory screen (/staff/inventory).
WHY THIS SHAPE EXISTS: an inventory service does not exist (no contract names one).
The screen still works over this recorded file, so the file IS the office's stock room
in demo form — APP-AUTHORED example records with provenance, the same pattern as
property/lot-lifecycle.json and operations/guarantee-instruments.json. lib/api-client/
inventory.ts is the only reader; live mode is unimplemented and says so.
WHAT IS REAL AND WHAT IS EXAMPLE:
· Casket rows carry the catalogue SKUs the storefront really sells (CSK-…); their
PRICE is never stored here — the reader resolves it from the durable catalogue so
an admin price edit on /staff/catalog is what the stock screen shows. Cost figures
are EXAMPLE stock-room costs (no client document prices a casket to the office).
· Supplier names are SAMPLE labels, never a real business. A row with no recorded
supplier stores null and the screen prints 'Not recorded'.
· Movements are the office's own record of what came in, went to a case or was
adjusted. Every item's movements sum to its on_hand — tests/fixture-contract/
inventory.test.ts pins that, and allocated movements reference real case numbers
from operations/cases.json.
· `by` names are employees from hr/employees.json — no invented staff.
NO WRITE PATH: the screen is read-only; purchasing and stock adjustments arrive with
the inventory service.
CLEAN START (captain, 2026-10-02): the recorded demo records are REMOVED. The office's reference data is kept; a record is written only when the office actually records one.
